name: empty lists and independent instances
input: two empty instances with later independent updates
test:
a = NestedTodoList()
b = NestedTodoList()
assert a.list_items() == []
assert b.list_items() == []
assert a.add('same', '') is None
b.add('same', 'other instance')
a.set_done('same', True)
assert a.list_items() == [('same', '', True, 0)]
assert b.list_items() == [('same', 'other instance', False, 0)]

name: pre-order preserves root and sibling insertion order
input: roots and descendants added in interleaved, non-lexicographic order
test:
todos = NestedTodoList()
todos.add('z', 'root')
todos.add('b', 'another root')
todos.add('y', 'child', 'z')
todos.add('x', 'child', 'z')
todos.add('a', 'grandchild', 'y')
todos.add('c', 'child', 'b')
todos.add('q', 'grandchild', 'x')
assert todos.list_items() == [('z', 'root', False, 0), ('y', 'child', False, 1), ('a', 'grandchild', False, 2), ('x', 'child', False, 1), ('q', 'grandchild', False, 2), ('b', 'another root', False, 0), ('c', 'child', False, 1)]

name: completion remains independent in both directions
input: mark parent done, complete child, undo parent, undo child
test:
todos = NestedTodoList()
todos.add('p', 'parent')
todos.add('c', 'child', 'p')
todos.add('g', 'grandchild', 'c')
assert todos.set_done('p', True) is None
assert todos.list_items() == [('p', 'parent', True, 0), ('c', 'child', False, 1), ('g', 'grandchild', False, 2)]
todos.set_done('c', True)
todos.set_done('p', False)
assert todos.list_items() == [('p', 'parent', False, 0), ('c', 'child', True, 1), ('g', 'grandchild', False, 2)]
todos.set_done('c', False)
todos.set_done('g', True)
todos.set_done('g', True)
assert todos.list_items() == [('p', 'parent', False, 0), ('c', 'child', False, 1), ('g', 'grandchild', True, 2)]

name: new children start undone under completed parents
input: add a child after setting its parent done
test:
todos = NestedTodoList()
todos.add('p', 'same text')
todos.set_done('p', True)
todos.add('c', 'same text', 'p')
assert todos.list_items() == [('p', 'same text', True, 0), ('c', 'same text', False, 1)]

name: invalid operations raise ValueError without mutations
input: duplicate IDs, unknown parent and unknown update target
test:
todos = NestedTodoList()
todos.add('p', 'parent')
todos.add('c', 'child', 'p')
todos.set_done('c', True)
expected = todos.list_items()
for operation in (lambda: todos.add('p', 'replacement'), lambda: todos.add('c', 'replacement', 'p'), lambda: todos.add('new', 'orphan', 'missing'), lambda: todos.set_done('missing', True)):
    try:
        operation()
    except ValueError:
        pass
    else:
        raise AssertionError('expected ValueError')
    assert todos.list_items() == expected
# A failed add must not reserve the new ID or damage sibling order.
todos.add('new', 'valid child', 'p')
assert todos.list_items() == expected + [('new', 'valid child', False, 1)]

name: snapshots are detached in both directions
input: mutate returned lists and update the original list afterward
test:
todos = NestedTodoList()
todos.add('p', 'parent')
old = todos.list_items()
view = todos.list_items()
view[0] = ('tampered', 'changed', True, 99)
view.append(('extra', 'extra', False, 0))
assert todos.list_items() == [('p', 'parent', False, 0)]
todos.set_done('p', True)
todos.add('c', 'child', 'p')
assert old == [('p', 'parent', False, 0)]
assert todos.list_items() == [('p', 'parent', True, 0), ('c', 'child', False, 1)]
view = todos.list_items()
view.clear()
assert len(todos.list_items()) == 2
